name: AIMessageBody
description: Atomic text body for plain-language AI responses — typography via @brand-bubble-body, size sm/md/lg, no bold or headings inside the atom.
intent: The voice of the AI. Plain, direct, readable — the atomic text body that carries every AI-generated sentence when no structured output is needed.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: children
props.hint: AI response prose — any React content. Keep formatting to plain text; no bold or headings.

props.name: size
props.hint: Typography size: sm=14px, md=16px (@brand-bubble-body), lg=18px. All inherit bubble-body weight and line-height.

notes: Color via var(--ai-neutral-text); font via F from ai-tokens.ts.

forbiddenUsage: When the response contains structured data — use the appropriate group component (AIAnalysisMessage, table, etc.)
For short labels or status text — use Standard text styles directly
Do not use bold or headings inside this atom — those belong in structured output groups
